contract: A23-91 server target hint: Swing / Release arg 1 = the client's pick (a monster Model). Valid only for a MANUAL attack and only when it is the Model of a monstersNear entry (alive, mine or nobody's, zone level gate, boss HitPad) within Range + HINT.Slack (2) and not hidden (rec._hidden / Model attribute Hidden). Lead 2026-10-10: a pick only changes which monsters are hit - it is ignored when the press without it would hit an enemy player or the goose (an enemy / the goose in the real front half; for Splash and Q one in the blast at today's centre: the nearest front monster, or me for a Q with no monster in range), and a press on the pick hits monsters only. With the pick: the aim follows it unless within HINT.KeepDeg (10 deg) of the facing, through a facing table only (the real root is never written; the no-pick A23-61 turn still writes it). Splash: centre = the pick. Multi: the pick first, then the nearest, no repeat. Around: the front half of the pick direction plus the pick itself even at Range + Slack (nobody else gets the slack). The queued manual swing keeps its pick; Q (ReleaseCenter Target) centres on the pick through SkillService (queued press too) or CombatService's fallback; a Self-centred Q ignores it. Anything else (wrong type, part, player character, dead / far / hidden / someone else's / gated monster, extra remote arguments, auto swings / auto Q) is ignored: the A23-61 swing of today. Differential: 800 seeded random scenes give the same enemy HP and goose tugs with and without the pick.
limitations: The real client pick (HUD.PickTarget) and the network delay are not simulated (tools/test_auto_face.py covers the client). The IsA("Model") guard is redundant with the Model identity check and is not mutated. Root writes are seen as a new root.CFrame value (the combat world's CFrame.lookAt double); the real client's own turn is not simulated. The differential property compares enemy HP and goose tugs only (allies' heals, Fx and monster damage may differ by design).
